acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Health status component shows colored dots for each service
Services monitored: Backend API, MCP Server, Redis, agentic-memories
LLM indicator shows active provider name (e.g., "Gemini 2.0", "Grok-4")
Tooltip on hover shows detailed status per component
Visual indication when any service is degraded (subtle warning)
No jarring UI changes on status updates (smooth transitions)
Initial loading state while first health check completes
Error handling if health endpoint unreachable

doc.title: Annie Web UI Epic
doc.snippet: Implement real-time health status display and LLM indicator. Poll /health/full every 30 seconds. Color coding for service status with tooltip on hover.

doc.title: Epic 20 Technical Context
doc.snippet: AppState includes health object with backend/mcp/redis/memories status ('ok'|'degraded'|'unavailable'), activeLLM string, and updateHealth action.

doc.title: Project Documentation
doc.section: LLM Observability with Langfuse - Health Check
doc.snippet: GET /health/full returns components status for mcp_server, redis, llm_api, agentic_memories, proactive_worker, langfuse. Overall status degrades if critical components unavailable.

file.reason: Implements GET /health/full endpoint that returns component health status - this is the API the useHealth hook must consume
Individual health check implementations showing response structure for each component
Shows available LLM providers and how active provider is determined - need to expose this in health response or config
LLM_PROVIDER env var determines active LLM - web UI needs access to this value
Story 20.1 creates the web/ directory structure including lib/hooks/ where useHealth.ts will live
Story 20.2 creates Header.tsx with placeholder slots for health indicators - this story fills those placeholders

frontend.note: Not yet created - will be set up in Story 20.1

constraints.constraint: No additional backend changes needed - /health/full endpoint already exists and returns all required component status
STATUS_COLORS mapping: ok->bg-green-500, degraded->bg-yellow-500, unavailable->bg-red-500, unknown->bg-gray-400
Health dots must fit in Header component right side between logo and LLM indicator
Polling interval is 30 seconds - do not poll more frequently to avoid unnecessary load
Tooltips must be keyboard accessible and screen-reader compatible
No jarring UI changes - use CSS transitions for color changes (transition-colors class)
Story 20.1 and 20.2 must be complete before this story - they create the web project and Header component

tests.standards: Frontend unit tests use Jest + React Testing Library.
